The '''78th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2025, were presented on February 7, 2026, at [[the Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Davis |last1=Hipes |first1=Patrick |title=DGA Awards: ''One Battle After Another'' Takes Top Film Prize; ''The Studio'', ''The Pitt'', ''Dying For Sex'' Lead TV – Full Winners List
